text: A giant named Gorm the Grim has his likeness carved into the gorge wall beside the River Avon. He likely began as a local deity. Later readers, including Christian priests, turned that figure into a monster. The carving was once said to show a cannibal. Traces of belief in this being also survive in Orkney.

okr.objective: Explain Gorm as a giant carved into the Avon gorge and a local deity turned monstrous.
key_results: Gorm's image appears on the gorge wall of the River Avon.
